candidates.text: =1.5|Specifications for the flag of Romanial = L; C = L Law no. 75/1994 specifies that the flag height is 2/3 of the width and that the color stripes are of equal size with blue at the hoist. Prior to 2023, the law specified the colors using the cobalt blue, chrome yellow and vermilion red pigments, but did not go into further detail. In the 2023 revision of the law, the pigments were replaced with exact color shades in the Pantone, CMYK, and RGB color models. {| class="wikitable" width=" " style="white-space: nowrap; text-align: " !
